property_summary: A depositor can withdraw each unit of credit exactly once: if an attacker re-enters withdrawAll during its payout, total ether paid out must equal its deposit (reference zeroes credit before the external call); the mutant pays the credit twice during reentrancy, so the attacker receives more than it deposited.
change_summary: Move the external call before the state updates so credit is cleared and balance reduced only after the transfer, allowing reentrancy with stale state, an observable behavioral change.
